scope: Atomic installation, addressing and functional testing of 25 explicitly selected addressable optical smoke detectors with compatible bases. Loop cable, control panel, sounders, power supply and the complete fire-alarm system are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved fire-alarm project organization, selected addressable-system manufacturer and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved detector and compatible-base schedule with exact product designations
mounting detail for the actual substrate and fire-resistant fasteners
method statement with installation labor and tool schedule
commissioning program with aerosol, dispenser, address programmer and labor quantities
supplier pack sizes and approved retained-spare quantities
forbiddenClaims: automatic detector, base, loop topology or fire-alarm system design
universal fastener, aerosol or conditional-accessory consumption
universal labor, tool, commissioning or logistics productivity
loop cable, control panel, sounder, power supply or complete fire-alarm system included
